answer: Each agent must lock a bond of computational tokens on a public jetty contract; the bond’s value is indexed to an ivory‑grade reputation score that rises only when the agent’s jade‑signed proofs of work are validated by a quorum of peers. If a subset of identities attempts a Sybil flood, any peer that detects duplicate proof patterns can submit a challenge, triggering an automated audit that slashes the offending bonds and redistributes them to honest validators.
